capabilities: Copy selections or whole notes to the clipboard
Preserve code blocks, LaTeX, Mermaid and frontmatter as editable source
Embed local vault images as data URLs
Configure enabled destinations and per-destination options
disambiguation: Not a file-copy or backup tool; it copies note content to the clipboard in a format chosen for the destination app.
extras: Version 1.0.4 targets Obsidian Desktop and its desktop clipboard implementation; MIT-licensed open source with public docs, tests and translations, and a separate Chinese product story.
problem: Each app interprets clipboard data differently, so pasted Obsidian notes lose headings, tables, links, images or code formatting.

relations.evidence: The copied content retains headings, inline formatting, lists, task states, tables, links, and source blocks in Google Docs.
Slack receives rich HTML plus readable plain text for its message editor.

summary: Copies a note or selection as rich HTML or Markdown tailored to a chosen destination app such as Google Docs, Word, Notion, Slack, email or WeChat.
